integrity: The three geometric strata, singularity profiles, and point counts follow from an algebraic proof; exact finite-field checks are corroborative, not an independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: The analytic classification of the cusps and the moduli quotient under PGL_3 are not determined; historic priority of the coefficient-extension stratification remains provisional. Finite-field verifier tests q=2,3 only, and the proof covers all prime powers.
title: Three geometric strata in the minimum-degree system through a finite projective plane
